Hello mixed! Happy past Yom Atzmaut! Have anyone dealt with deposits when applying for gradual process. I heard some stories when misrad hapnim (if I remember correctly) asked for a deposit from mixed couples where non-Israeli partner was female and from post-Soviet country. Is there specific cases where it applies to, or it’s random and does finished second degree in Israeli university and current third degree in the same Israeli university might affect that person will not assigned for paying that deposit?
Would appreciate any stories and facts, thank you all!
